archiveTitle: Evening Brief | New Announcements and Release Moves

entries.headline: Open-world boat fishing game Little Lake announced, planned for Q2 2027
entries.summary: Tiny Boat Games unveiled this fishing adventure inspired by the Great Lakes region; players can sail to explore islands, collect fish and treasures, and trade at night markets to upgrade gear. The Steam page is live, with media reporting a Switch version in development.
entries.verification: Opened the specific Steam product page to confirm developer, gameplay, and PC version; Q2 2027 and Switch version relayed from developer announcement via AUTOMATON, Steam currently only shows Coming soon, so not marked official.
entries.timeNote: Media page time converted/displayed in Beijing time and within a fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam key art for Little Lake, used as the news image for this entry

entries.headline: Colopl announces free-to-play mobile game Wiz Generation, planned for this winter
entries.summary: The new title is a real-time quiz action RPG for iOS/Android, featuring over 100,000 questions, ranked matches, and live quiz content with synchronized player participation; pre-registration is now open.
entries.verification: Opened the official account/website links embedded in the media and verified the developer, platforms, and winter release window; AUTOMATON provides independent cross-reporting.
entries.timeNote: Media page time converted/displayed in Beijing time and within a fixed window.

entries.headline: Keroro军曹☆ Hachamecha TV Show announced, launching on Switch and PC in December
entries.summary: RENGAME unveiled a casual mini-game collection based on the new anime series; players control the Keroro squad to tackle various shows and compete for prize money. A playable demo is also planned before the full release.
entries.verification: Opened the official website and official account links in the specific report, and verified platforms, month, and demo plans via AUTOMATON.
entries.timeNote: Media page time converted/displayed in Beijing time and within a fixed window.

entries.headline: DRAPLINE confirmed to end Early Access and launch 1.0 on September 24
entries.summary: The full version will add the latter-half mode "DRAGON'S DISCIPLINE" and 25 endings, significantly expanding content; the price will also adjust from 1200 yen to 1680 yen.
entries.verification: Opened the Steam product page to confirm the title, developer, Early Access status, and Simplified Chinese support; September 24 and full version details come from AUTOMATON's relay of the publisher's announcement today, while the Steam page has not yet updated the date, so downgraded to media_report.
entries.timeNote: Media page time converted/displayed in Beijing time and within a fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam key art for DRAPLINE, used as the news image for this entry

entries.headline: thatgamecompany establishes publishing division thatgamepublisher
entries.summary: The developer of Sky: Children of the Light begins supporting external teams as a publisher; the website is now live. Co-founder Jenova Chen stated the goal of channeling funds from successful projects into new creators and AA-level projects.
entries.verification: The official website directly confirms the existence of the new publishing brand; business motivation and scope come from media relay of a GamesIndustry.biz interview, so the entire entry is treated as media_report.
entries.timeNote: Media page time converted/displayed in Beijing time and within a fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Official thatgamepublisher logo, used as the news image for this company entry

entries.headline: [Unconfirmed] Heroes of Might and Magic III original Steam launch initially missing game files, possibly fixed after 15:00
entries.summary: After the Steam release, multiple buyers reported downloads of only about 23KB and inability to launch; SteamDB subsequently recorded the public branch adding approximately 928MB of files. Ubisoft had not publicly responded as of reporting, so only the anomaly reports and branch changes are confirmed here, not an official fix.
entries.verification: Steam page confirms the product went live on August 25; missing files come from contemporaneous user feedback and AUTOMATON verification, while SteamDB branch changes only support "possible fix." No official response yet, so unconfirmed and continuing tracking.
entries.timeNote: Media page time converted/displayed in Beijing time and within a fixed window.

mediaAlts.alt: Official Steam cover for Heroes of Might and Magic III, used as the replacement image for the launch anomaly news

entries.headline: Alliance of Valiant Arms confirmed to end Japanese service on October 28
entries.summary: The operator announced that this online FPS, running since 2008, will shut down after 6,541 days; a final update is scheduled for September 9, and the series' new title AVA RE:BIRTH is still planned for this fall.
entries.verification: The official page directly confirms the shutdown date, final update, and new title window, but only shows the date August 26 without a specific time; media reports appeared at 17:02, which cannot be used to infer the announcement time, so time_status remains uncertain.
entries.timeNote: The official announcement only notes the date; the specific release time was not disclosed.
